verses.original: Ὦ ἀνόητοι Γαλάται τίς ὑμᾶς ἐβάσκανεν οἷς κατ’ ὀφθαλμοὺς Ἰησοῦς Χριστὸς προεγράφη ἐσταυρωμένος
verses.transliteration: Ō anoētoi Galatai tis hymas ebaskanen hois kat’ ophthalmous Iēsous Christos proegraphē estaurōmenos
verses.literal: O foolish Galatians Who has bewitched you Before your very eyes Jesus Christ was clearly portrayed as crucified
verses.literalPt: Ó insensatos gálatas! Quem vos fascinou a vós, ante cujos olhos foi representado Jesus Cristo como crucificado?

verses.original: τοῦτο μόνον θέλω μαθεῖν ἀφ’ ὑμῶν ἐξ ἔργων νόμου τὸ Πνεῦμα ἐλάβετε ἢ ἐξ ἀκοῆς πίστεως
verses.transliteration: touto monon thelō mathein aph’ hymōn ex ergōn nomou to Pneuma elabete ē ex akoēs pisteōs
verses.literal: I would like to learn just one thing from you Did you receive the Spirit by works of the law or by hearing with faith
verses.literalPt: Só isso quero saber de vós: recebestes o Espírito por obras da lei ou pela mensagem da fé?

verses.original: Οὕτως ἀνόητοί ἐστε ἐναρξάμενοι Πνεύματι νῦν σαρκὶ ἐπιτελεῖσθε
verses.transliteration: Houtōs anoētoi este enarxamenoi Pneumati nyn sarki epiteleisthe
verses.literal: Are you so foolish After starting in the Spirit are you now finishing in the flesh
verses.literalPt: Sois tão insensatos? Tendo começado no Espírito, estais agora vos aperfeiçoando na carne?

verses.original: τοσαῦτα ἐπάθετε εἰκῇ εἴ γε καὶ εἰκῇ
verses.transliteration: tosauta epathete eikē ei ge kai eikē
verses.literal: Have you suffered so much for nothing if it really was . . . for nothing
verses.literalPt: Sofrestes tantas coisas em vão? Se é que, na verdade, foram em vão.

verses.original: ὁ οὖν ἐπιχορηγῶν ὑμῖν τὸ Πνεῦμα καὶ ἐνεργῶν δυνάμεις ἐν ὑμῖν ἐξ ἔργων νόμου ἢ ἐξ ἀκοῆς πίστεως
verses.transliteration: ho oun epichorēgōn hymin to Pneuma kai energōn dynameis en hymin ex ergōn nomou ē ex akoēs pisteōs
verses.literal: Does God lavish His Spirit on you and work miracles among you because you practice the law or because you hear and believe
verses.literalPt: Aquele que vos subministra o Espírito e opera milagres entre vós, acaso fá-lo ele por obras da lei ou pela mensagem da fé?

verses.original: Καθὼς Ἀβραὰμ ἐπίστευσεν τῷ Θεῷ καὶ ἐλογίσθη αὐτῷ εἰς δικαιοσύνην
verses.transliteration: Kathōs Abraam episteusen tō Theō kai elogisthē autō eis dikaiosynēn
verses.literal: So also Abraham believed God and it was credited to him as righteousness
verses.literalPt: Justamente como Abraão creu a Deus, e foi-lhe imputado para justiça.

verses.original: Γινώσκετε ἄρα ὅτι οἱ ἐκ πίστεως οὗτοι υἱοί εἰσιν Ἀβραάμ
verses.transliteration: Ginōskete ara hoti hoi ek pisteōs houtoi huioi eisin Abraam
verses.literal: Understand then that those who have faith are sons of Abraham
verses.literalPt: Sabei, pois, que os que são da fé, estes são filhos de Abraão.

verses.original: προϊδοῦσα δὲ ἡ γραφὴ ὅτι ἐκ πίστεως δικαιοῖ τὰ ἔθνη ὁ Θεὸς προευηγγελίσατο τῷ Ἀβραὰμ ὅτι Ἐνευλογηθήσονται ἐν σοὶ πάντα τὰ ἔθνη
verses.transliteration: proidousa de hē graphē hoti ek pisteōs dikaioi ta ethnē ho Theos proeuēngelisato tō Abraam hoti Eneulogēthēsontai en soi panta ta ethnē
verses.literal: The Scripture foresaw that God would justify the Gentiles by faith and foretold the gospel to Abraham All nations will be blessed through you
verses.literalPt: A Escritura, prevendo que Deus justificaria os gentios pela fé, de antemão, anunciou as boas-novas a Abraão: Em ti serão bem-aventuradas todas as nações.

verses.original: ὥστε οἱ ἐκ πίστεως εὐλογοῦνται σὺν τῷ πιστῷ Ἀβραάμ
verses.transliteration: hōste hoi ek pisteōs eulogountai syn tō pistō Abraam
verses.literal: So those who have faith are blessed along with Abraham the man of faith
verses.literalPt: Assim, os que são da fé são bem-aventurados com o fiel Abraão.

verses.original: Ὅσοι γὰρ ἐξ ἔργων νόμου εἰσὶν ὑπὸ κατάραν εἰσίν γέγραπται γὰρ ὅτι Ἐπικατάρατος πᾶς ὃς οὐκ ἐμμένει πᾶσιν τοῖς γεγραμμένοις ἐν τῷ βιβλίῳ τοῦ νόμου τοῦ ποιῆσαι αὐτά
verses.transliteration: Hosoi gar ex ergōn nomou eisin hypo kataran eisin gegraptai gar hoti Epikataratos pas hos ouk emmenei pasin tois gegrammenois en tō bibliō tou nomou tou poiēsai auta
verses.literal: All who rely on . . . works of the law are under a curse For it is written Cursed is everyone who does not continue to do everything written in the Book of the Law
verses.literalPt: Pois todos quantos são das obras da lei estão sob a maldição; porque está escrito: Maldito todo aquele que não permanece em todas as coisas escritas no livro da Lei para fazê-las.

verses.original: ὅτι δὲ ἐν νόμῳ οὐδεὶς δικαιοῦται παρὰ τῷ Θεῷ δῆλον ὅτι Ὁ δίκαιος ἐκ πίστεως ζήσεται
verses.transliteration: hoti de en nomō oudeis dikaioutai para tō Theō dēlon hoti Ho dikaios ek pisteōs zēsetai
verses.literal: Now it is clear that no one is justified before God by the law because The righteous will live by faith
verses.literalPt: É claro que, pela Lei, ninguém é justificado diante de Deus, porque: O justo viverá da fé.

verses.original: ὁ δὲ νόμος οὐκ ἔστιν ἐκ πίστεως ἀλλ’ Ὁ ποιήσας αὐτὰ ζήσεται ἐν αὐτοῖς
verses.transliteration: ho de nomos ouk estin ek pisteōs all’ Ho poiēsas auta zēsetai en autois
verses.literal: The law however is not based on faith on the contrary The man who does these things will live by them
verses.literalPt: A Lei não é da fé, mas: Aquele que faz essas coisas viverá por elas.

verses.original: Χριστὸς ἡμᾶς ἐξηγόρασεν ἐκ τῆς κατάρας τοῦ νόμου γενόμενος ὑπὲρ ἡμῶν κατάρα ὅτι γέγραπται Ἐπικατάρατος πᾶς ὁ κρεμάμενος ἐπὶ ξύλου
verses.transliteration: Christos hēmas exēgorasen ek tēs kataras tou nomou genomenos hyper hēmōn katara hoti gegraptai Epikataratos pas ho kremamenos epi xylou
verses.literal: Christ redeemed us from the curse of the law by becoming a curse for us For it is written Cursed is everyone who is hung on a tree
verses.literalPt: Cristo nos remiu da maldição da Lei, tornando-se maldição por nós, porque está escrito: Maldito todo aquele que é pendurado no madeiro,

verses.original: ἵνα εἰς τὰ ἔθνη ἡ εὐλογία τοῦ Ἀβραὰμ γένηται ἐν Ἰησοῦ Χριστῷ ἵνα τὴν ἐπαγγελίαν τοῦ Πνεύματος λάβωμεν διὰ τῆς πίστεως
verses.transliteration: hina eis ta ethnē hē eulogia tou Abraam genētai en Iēsou Christō hina tēn epangelian tou Pneumatos labōmen dia tēs pisteōs
verses.literal: He redeemed us in order that the blessing promised to Abraham would come to the Gentiles in Christ Jesus so that by faith we might receive the promise of the Spirit
verses.literalPt: para que sobre os gentios viesse a bênção de Abraão em Jesus Cristo, a fim de que nós recebêssemos a promessa do Espírito, por meio da fé.

verses.original: Ἀδελφοί κατὰ ἄνθρωπον λέγω ὅμως ἀνθρώπου κεκυρωμένην διαθήκην οὐδεὶς ἀθετεῖ ἢ ἐπιδιατάσσεται
verses.transliteration: Adelphoi kata anthrōpon legō homōs anthrōpou kekyrōmenēn diathēkēn oudeis athetei ē epidiatassetai
verses.literal: Brothers let me put this in human terms . . . Even a human covenant . . . once it is ratified cannot be canceled or amended
verses.literalPt: Irmãos, falo como homem. Ainda que a aliança seja só de homem, contudo, uma vez confirmada, ninguém a anula ou lhe acrescenta coisa alguma.

verses.original: τῷ δὲ Ἀβραὰμ ἐρρέθησαν αἱ ἐπαγγελίαι καὶ τῷ σπέρματι αὐτοῦ οὐ λέγει Καὶ τοῖς σπέρμασιν ὡς ἐπὶ πολλῶν ἀλλ’ ὡς ἐφ’ ἑνός Καὶ τῷ σπέρματί σου ὅς ἐστιν Χριστός
verses.transliteration: tō de Abraam errethēsan hai epangeliai kai tō spermati autou ou legei Kai tois spermasin hōs epi pollōn all’ hōs eph’ henos Kai tō spermati sou hos estin Christos
verses.literal: The promises were spoken to Abraham and to his seed The Scripture does not say and to seeds meaning many but and to your seed meaning One who is Christ
verses.literalPt: Ora, a Abraão foram feitas as promessas e à sua semente. Não diz: E às sementes, como falando de muitos; mas, como de um: E à tua semente, a qual é Cristo.

verses.original: Τοῦτο δὲ λέγω διαθήκην προκεκυρωμένην ὑπὸ τοῦ Θεοῦ ὁ μετὰ τετρακόσια καὶ τριάκοντα ἔτη γεγονὼς νόμος οὐκ ἀκυροῖ εἰς τὸ καταργῆσαι τὴν ἐπαγγελίαν
verses.transliteration: Touto de legō diathēkēn prokekyrōmenēn hypo tou Theou ho meta tetrakosia kai triakonta etē gegonōs nomos ouk akyroi eis to katargēsai tēn epangelian
verses.literal: What I mean is this The law that came 430 . . . . . . years later does not revoke the covenant previously established by God so as to nullify the promise
verses.literalPt: Digo isto: Uma aliança previamente confirmada por Deus, a Lei, que veio quatrocentos e trinta anos depois, não a ab-roga, de modo a tornar de nenhum efeito a promessa.

verses.original: εἰ γὰρ ἐκ νόμου ἡ κληρονομία οὐκέτι ἐξ ἐπαγγελίας τῷ δὲ Ἀβραὰμ δι’ ἐπαγγελίας κεχάρισται ὁ Θεός
verses.transliteration: ei gar ek nomou hē klēronomia ouketi ex epangelias tō de Abraam di’ epangelias kecharistai ho Theos
verses.literal: For if the inheritance depends on the law then it no longer depends on a promise but God freely granted it to Abraham through a promise
verses.literalPt: Pois, se da Lei vem a herança, não é mais da promessa; mas pela promessa é que Deus a deu a Abraão.

verses.original: Τί οὖν ὁ νόμος τῶν παραβάσεων χάριν προσετέθη ἄχρις οὗ ἔλθῃ τὸ σπέρμα ᾧ ἐπήγγελται διαταγεὶς δι’ ἀγγέλων ἐν χειρὶ μεσίτου
verses.transliteration: Ti oun ho nomos tōn parabaseōn charin prosetethē achris hou elthē to sperma hō epēngeltai diatageis di’ angelōn en cheiri mesitou
verses.literal: Why then was the law given It was added because of transgressions until the arrival of the seed to whom the promise referred It was administered through angels by a mediator
verses.literalPt: Que é, pois, a Lei? Foi acrescentada por causa das transgressões, até que viesse a semente a quem se fez a promessa, tendo sido ordenada mediante anjos, pela mão de um mediador.

verses.original: ὁ δὲ μεσίτης ἑνὸς οὐκ ἔστιν ὁ δὲ Θεὸς εἷς ἐστιν
verses.transliteration: ho de mesitēs henos ouk estin ho de Theos heis estin
verses.literal: A mediator is unnecessary however for only one party but God is one
verses.literalPt: O mediador, porém, não o é de um só, mas Deus é só um.

verses.original: Ὁ οὖν νόμος κατὰ τῶν ἐπαγγελιῶν τοῦ Θεοῦ μὴ γένοιτο εἰ γὰρ ἐδόθη νόμος ὁ δυνάμενος ζωοποιῆσαι ὄντως ἐκ νόμου ἂν ἦν ἡ δικαιοσύνη
verses.transliteration: Ho oun nomos kata tōn epangeliōn tou Theou mē genoito ei gar edothē nomos ho dynamenos zōopoiēsai ontōs ek nomou an ēn hē dikaiosynē
verses.literal: Is the law then opposed to the promises of God Certainly not For if a law had been given that could impart life then righteousness would certainly have come from the law
verses.literalPt: É a Lei, porventura, contra as promessas de Deus? De modo nenhum! Pois, se tivesse sido dada uma lei que pudesse dar vida, a justiça, na verdade, teria sido pela Lei.

verses.original: ἀλλὰ συνέκλεισεν ἡ γραφὴ τὰ πάντα ὑπὸ ἁμαρτίαν ἵνα ἡ ἐπαγγελία ἐκ πίστεως Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ δοθῇ τοῖς πιστεύουσιν
verses.transliteration: alla synekleisen hē graphē ta panta hypo hamartian hina hē epangelia ek pisteōs Iēsou Christou dothē tois pisteuousin
verses.literal: But the Scripture pronounces all things confined by sin so that by faith in Jesus Christ the promise might be given to those who believe
verses.literalPt: A Escritura, porém, encerrou todas as coisas debaixo do pecado, para que a promessa pela fé em Jesus Cristo fosse dada aos que creem.

verses.original: Πρὸ τοῦ δὲ ἐλθεῖν τὴν πίστιν ὑπὸ νόμον ἐφρουρούμεθα συνκλειόμενοι εἰς τὴν μέλλουσαν πίστιν ἀποκαλυφθῆναι
verses.transliteration: Pro tou de elthein tēn pistin hypo nomon ephrouroumetha synkleiomenoi eis tēn mellousan pistin apokalyphthēnai
verses.literal: Before this faith came we were held in custody under the law locked up until faith should be revealed
verses.literalPt: Mas, antes que viesse a fé, estávamos debaixo da guarda da Lei, encerrados para a fé que havia de ser revelada.

verses.original: ὥστε ὁ νόμος παιδαγωγὸς ἡμῶν γέγονεν εἰς Χριστόν ἵνα ἐκ πίστεως δικαιωθῶμεν
verses.transliteration: hōste ho nomos paidagōgos hēmōn gegonen eis Christon hina ek pisteōs dikaiōthōmen
verses.literal: So the law became our guardian to lead us to Christ that we might be justified by faith
verses.literalPt: Assim, a Lei se tornou nosso pedagogo, para conduzir-nos a Cristo, a fim de sermos justificados pela fé.

verses.original: ἐλθούσης δὲ τῆς πίστεως οὐκέτι ὑπὸ παιδαγωγόν ἐσμεν
verses.transliteration: elthousēs de tēs pisteōs ouketi hypo paidagōgon esmen
verses.literal: Now that faith has come we are no longer under a guardian
verses.literalPt: Mas, tendo vindo a fé, não estamos mais debaixo de pedagogo.

verses.original: Πάντες γὰρ υἱοὶ Θεοῦ ἐστε διὰ τῆς πίστεως ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ
verses.transliteration: Pantes gar huioi Theou este dia tēs pisteōs en Christō Iēsou
verses.literal: You are all sons of God through faith in Christ Jesus
verses.literalPt: Pois todos vós sois filhos de Deus, mediante a fé em Cristo Jesus;

verses.original: ὅσοι γὰρ εἰς Χριστὸν ἐβαπτίσθητε Χριστὸν ἐνεδύσασθε
verses.transliteration: hosoi gar eis Christon ebaptisthēte Christon enedysasthe
verses.literal: For all of you who were baptized into Christ have clothed yourselves with Christ
verses.literalPt: porque tantos quantos fostes batizados em Cristo vos revestistes de Cristo.

verses.original: οὐκ ἔνι Ἰουδαῖος οὐδὲ Ἕλλην οὐκ ἔνι δοῦλος οὐδὲ ἐλεύθερος οὐκ ἔνι ἄρσεν καὶ θῆλυ πάντες γὰρ ὑμεῖς εἷς ἐστε ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ
verses.transliteration: ouk eni Ioudaios oude Hellēn ouk eni doulos oude eleutheros ouk eni arsen kai thēly pantes gar hymeis heis este en Christō Iēsou
verses.literal: There is neither Jew nor Greek - slave nor free - male nor female for you are all one in Christ Jesus
verses.literalPt: Não pode haver judeu nem grego, não pode haver escravo nem livre, não pode haver homem nem mulher, pois todos vós sois um em Cristo Jesus.

verses.original: εἰ δὲ ὑμεῖς Χριστοῦ ἄρα τοῦ Ἀβραὰμ σπέρμα ἐστέ κατ’ ἐπαγγελίαν κληρονόμοι
verses.transliteration: ei de hymeis Christou ara tou Abraam sperma este kat’ epangelian klēronomoi
verses.literal: And if you belong to Christ then you are Abraham’s seed and heirs according to the promise
verses.literalPt: Mas, se vós sois de Cristo, então, sois semente de Abraão, herdeiros segundo a promessa.
